entities.name: Bálint Magosi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bálint Magosi is a Hungarian professional ice hockey forward who currently plays for DVTK Jegesmedvék of the MOL Liga. He has formerly played with Austrian Hockey League side Alba Volán Székesfehérvár. Magosi joined the club from county rivals Dunaújvárosi Acélbikák in June 2011.
